archetypes.name: Four operations
archetypes.strategy: Standard written or mental method
archetypes.traps: Careless carrying/borrowing

archetypes.name: Missing number/digit
archetypes.strategy: Work backwards from the known result
archetypes.traps: Sign/direction reversal errors

archetypes.name: Powers/indices
archetypes.clues: "7 to the 5 means 7×7×7×7×7" style definitions given in-question
archetypes.strategy: Apply the given definition literally, or list out powers until you find a match
archetypes.traps: Confusing base and exponent

archetypes.name: Rounding & bounds
archetypes.strategy: Find the true min/max range first, then combine as the question asks
archetypes.traps: Forgetting the range is inclusive on one side and exclusive on the other

archetypes.name: Number properties/logic
archetypes.strategy: Test with examples; look for a counterexample before assuming a pattern holds
archetypes.traps: Assuming a pattern holds without checking a counterexample

archetypes.name: Fraction/decimal arithmetic
archetypes.clues: Mixed numbers, decimals in a calculation
archetypes.strategy: Common denominator / column method
archetypes.traps: Mixed number conversion errors

archetypes.name: Missing number fraction
archetypes.strategy: Isolate the unknown algebraically
archetypes.traps: Cross-multiplication errors

archetypes.name: Percentage of amount
archetypes.strategy: Convert to decimal/fraction, multiply
archetypes.traps: None major, but slow if 10%/5% building blocks aren't used

archetypes.name: Successive percentage
archetypes.strategy: Apply sequentially, NOT additively
archetypes.traps: Adding the percentages instead of compounding them

archetypes.name: Reverse percentage
archetypes.clues: "After a 20% increase it costs £108, find the original"
archetypes.strategy: Set up as (100+x)% = final amount, solve for 100%
archetypes.traps: Taking x% off the final amount instead of solving properly

archetypes.name: Letter-substitution ratio system
archetypes.clues: "A is double B, B is three times C"
archetypes.strategy: Express all quantities in one variable, then solve
archetypes.traps: Misreading which variable is the multiplier

archetypes.name: Money/amount division in ratio
archetypes.clues: "£110 divided so X gets £6 more than Y"
archetypes.strategy: Set up algebraic parts, sum to the total
archetypes.traps: Off-by-one in 'more than' vs 'times'

archetypes.name: Rate/proportion
archetypes.strategy: Unitary method - find the rate per 1 unit first
archetypes.traps: Unit conversion errors compounding the rate error

archetypes.name: Unit conversion
archetypes.strategy: Chain of conversion factors
archetypes.traps: Multiplying instead of dividing (or vice versa)

archetypes.name: Area/perimeter (numeric)
archetypes.clues: Given dimensions, find area or perimeter
archetypes.strategy: Direct formula application
archetypes.traps: Confusing area and perimeter formulas

archetypes.name: Area/perimeter (algebraic)
archetypes.clues: Expressions like x+5, 2x+2 as side lengths
archetypes.strategy: Set up an equation from the given total, solve for x
archetypes.traps: Forgetting to substitute x back if the actual length (not x) is asked for

archetypes.name: Rounding-based min/max area/perimeter
archetypes.strategy: Find the bound combination that minimises/maximises
archetypes.traps: Using the rounded value instead of the true boundary

archetypes.name: Function/formula machine (forward)
archetypes.strategy: Apply operations in the order shown
archetypes.traps: Order of operations errors

archetypes.name: Function/formula machine (reverse)
archetypes.strategy: Reverse each operation, in reverse order
archetypes.traps: Forgetting to invert the operation order, not just each operation

archetypes.name: Simultaneous equations (word form)
archetypes.strategy: Elimination/substitution dressed in a real-world context
archetypes.traps: Sign or term errors when setting up the equations

archetypes.name: 'Think of a number' reverse reasoning
archetypes.strategy: Single-step or short-chain inverse
archetypes.traps: Applying operations in the wrong order when reversing

archetypes.name: Letter-system algebra
archetypes.clues: A=B+3, C=3B, D=B² style, then evaluate expressions
archetypes.strategy: Substitute systematically, one variable at a time
archetypes.traps: Sequencing errors - solving for a term before its dependency is known

archetypes.name: Sequence forward term
archetypes.strategy: Apply the rule N times, or find a formula
archetypes.traps: Off-by-one in term counting

archetypes.name: Sequence reverse term
archetypes.clues: "At what term does it reach/equal X?"
archetypes.strategy: Set up an equation and solve for the term number
archetypes.traps: Non-integer solutions when the problem implies an integer term

archetypes.name: Sequence comparison
archetypes.clues: Two sequences, find when they're equal or their sum reaches a value
archetypes.strategy: Combine the rules algebraically
archetypes.traps: Assuming both sequences start counting from the same term incorrectly

archetypes.name: Angle geometry
archetypes.strategy: Apply angle sum rules
archetypes.traps: Forgetting isosceles base angles are equal

archetypes.name: Algebraic angle geometry
archetypes.strategy: Sum = 180 (triangle) or the appropriate total, solve for x
archetypes.traps: Not substituting x back if the actual angle (not x) is asked for

archetypes.name: Coordinate geometry
archetypes.clues: Plot/complete coordinates on a line or shape
archetypes.strategy: Use the gradient/pattern between known points
archetypes.traps: Sign errors on negative coordinates

archetypes.name: Transformations
archetypes.clues: Rotation/reflection of a shape about a point
archetypes.strategy: Track one vertex at a time systematically
archetypes.traps: Confusing clockwise/anticlockwise

archetypes.name: Spatial/3D reasoning
archetypes.clues: Nets of cubes, "which one is different"
archetypes.strategy: Mental folding or systematic elimination
archetypes.traps: Rushing without checking all faces

archetypes.name: Mean (forward)
archetypes.strategy: Sum ÷ count
archetypes.traps: None major

archetypes.name: Mean (reverse)
archetypes.clues: "Average of 6 is 88, two more join making average 90, find their average"
archetypes.strategy: Use total = mean × count, work with totals not averages
archetypes.traps: Trying to average the averages directly

archetypes.name: Data interpretation
archetypes.strategy: Read carefully, cross-reference axis labels
archetypes.traps: Misreading which axis is which

archetypes.name: Combinatorics
archetypes.clues: "How many different meals from X choices and Y choices"
archetypes.strategy: Multiply choice counts (or list systematically)
archetypes.traps: Confusing combinations with permutations

archetypes.name: Duration calculation
archetypes.clues: Start/end times or elapsed time given
archetypes.strategy: Convert to minutes, calculate, convert back
archetypes.traps: 60-minute carrying errors (not base 100)

archetypes.name: Timetable reading
archetypes.strategy: Extract relevant rows/columns carefully
archetypes.traps: Reading the wrong row (e.g. morning vs afternoon)

archetypes.name: Time zone problems
archetypes.strategy: Track a single reference time zone throughout
archetypes.traps: Losing track after multiple time zone shifts

archetypes.name: Always/sometimes/never true reasoning
archetypes.clues: "Is this statement always, sometimes, or never true?"
archetypes.strategy: Test with several examples; one counterexample disproves 'always'
archetypes.traps: Stopping after one confirming example

archetypes.name: Number properties/logic
archetypes.strategy: Work from known values inward/outward systematically
archetypes.traps: Missing a constraint or assuming a rule not actually stated

thinking_skills.name: Automatic Recall
thinking_skills.description: Facts and procedures that should be instant - times tables, basic conversions, standard percentage of an amount.

thinking_skills.name: Calculation
thinking_skills.description: Multi-step arithmetic or algebraic working, applied correctly and carefully.

thinking_skills.name: Application
thinking_skills.description: Recognising which known method fits a real-world scenario and applying it.

thinking_skills.name: Pattern Recognition
thinking_skills.description: Spotting the rule behind a sequence or a set of coordinates.

thinking_skills.name: Reverse Reasoning
thinking_skills.description: Working backwards from a known result to an unknown starting point.

thinking_skills.name: Logical Deduction
thinking_skills.description: Testing statements or constraints systematically to reach a certain conclusion.

thinking_skills.name: Optimisation
thinking_skills.description: Finding the best (smallest/largest/cheapest) outcome within given constraints.

thinking_skills.name: Multi-stage Planning
thinking_skills.description: Combining several steps or pieces of information in the right order to reach an answer.

importance_tiers.name: Must Get
importance_tiers.description: Appears almost every year, low variance in difficulty. Missing these is a red flag.

importance_tiers.name: Should Get
importance_tiers.description: Solidly within reach for a well-prepared candidate.

importance_tiers.name: Strong Candidate
importance_tiers.description: Separates well-prepared candidates from average ones.

importance_tiers.name: Separator
importance_tiers.description: The hardest questions, usually at the end of the paper - intentionally designed to differentiate top scorers.
